name: ransom_note_scan
description: Find the ransom notes across a tree and pull out what identifies the campaign: onion addresses, contact emails and portals, the victim identifier a negotiator needs, wallet addresses, and where each copy of the note was dropped and when.

max_size.description: Largest file to treat as a note (default 200000)

limit.description: Preview notes returned inline when the job OUT directory can hold the complete ransom-notes.jsonl (default 100); ignored when no lossless output directory exists
